design_constraints: Keep the implementation in the existing static HTML/CSS/JS architecture; do not add a frontend framework, package manager, backend, or remote dependency.

Reuse the RedStore visual language: Poppins typography, #ff523b accent, rounded pill controls, radial pale-red surfaces, the existing .col-4 product-card grid, and the existing responsive breakpoints.
The 'Shop the range' category filter must sit above the product grid on products.html and reuse the store's own product cards; do not replace product content with generic placeholders.
The category tab row must wrap cleanly and the product grid must stay readable at 390px without horizontal overflow.

change_completion: The products page shows a 'Shop the range' category filter bar with All products / Tees / Footwear / Accessories tabs above the product grid.
Clicking a category tab filters the visible product cards and updates the live count readout to 'Showing N of 12 · <Category>'.
design_consistency: The filter bar follows the existing RedStore static HTML/CSS style (Poppins, #ff523b pills, radial pale-red surface) and sits above the .col-4 product grid.

The same 'Shop the range' rail is surfaced on the home page and the product-detail page so the category filter reads as a store-wide feature, and the cart, account, navigation, footer, and imagery are preserved.
regression: Original home, products, product detail, cart, account, nav, product cards, cart totals, checkout handoff, Login/Register, and footer surfaces remain visible.
No external dependency, framework rewrite, or placeholder replacement is introduced.
responsive: The category tab row wraps and the product grid stacks cleanly on 390px mobile without horizontal overflow.
The desktop products page keeps the filter bar and the product grid readable in one continuous flow.

problem_statement: The SamwitAdhikary Ecommerce RedStore template has a real commerce journey across `index.html`, `products.html`, `product_details.html`, `cart.html`, and `account.html`, but the products page just lists a static twelve-item grid with a decorative sort dropdown that does nothing, so shoppers cannot narrow the catalog by category. Extend the store with its own 'Shop the range' category filter: add a filter bar above the products grid with All products / Tees / Footwear / Accessories tabs that actually filter the twelve product cards and drive a live count readout ('Showing N of 12 · <Category>'), and surface the same 'Shop the range' rail on the home and product-detail pages so it reads as a store-wide feature. Preserve the RedStore styling, the product cards, the cart table, totals, the cart-to-checkout handoff, the account page, the footer, and the responsive behavior.
required_content: On `products.html`, add a visible 'Shop the range' category filter bar above the product grid with exact tab labels All products, Tees, Footwear, and Accessories.
The filter bar must include a visible live count readout that reads exactly 'Showing 12 of 12 · All products' in the initial state.
Clicking the Footwear tab must filter the grid to the footwear products and update the readout to exactly 'Showing 3 of 12 · Footwear'.
The task must be grounded in the browser-observed category-tab click interaction on products.html.
The products grid must contain twelve product cards, each tagged with a category so the filter can act on them.
The same 'Shop the range' rail (title text Shop the range) must also appear on `index.html` and `product_details.html`.

Preserve the existing cart page: the cart table labels Product, Quantity, Subtotal, the three cart rows, Subtotal, Tax, Total, and the Cart to checkout handoff with Continue to account checkout and Keep shopping links.
Preserve original navigation and page surfaces including RedStore, Home, Products, Account, Login, and Register.
Desktop and 390px mobile products states must have no horizontal overflow after the filter bar is added.
scoring_notes: A correct patch adds the store's own category filter over the existing RedStore product grid. Leaving the tab row as a fixed non-wrapping strip that overflows mobile, collapsing the product grid into overlapping/clipped cards, making the active tab illegible, omitting the 'Shop the range' rail from the home or product-detail page, or wiring the tabs so the grid and count readout stay frozen on 'Showing 12 of 12 · All products' should fail responsive, regression, cross-page DOM, or interaction checks.
state_constraints: desktop_initial verifies the RedStore home page, navigation, and the Shop the range rail remain visible.
mobile_initial verifies the RedStore home page at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
tablet_initial verifies the RedStore home page at an intermediate viewport.
desktop_products verifies the Shop the range filter bar, its four category tabs, the live count readout, and the twelve product cards.
desktop_product_detail verifies the product gallery, Add To Cart button, and the Shop the range rail remain visible.
desktop_cart verifies the cart table, totals, and the preserved cart-to-checkout handoff.
desktop_account verifies the account page still contains Login and Register surfaces.
mobile_products verifies the filter bar and product grid stack without horizontal overflow at 390px.
desktop_products_footwear clicks the Footwear tab and verifies the grid filters and the count readout updates to Showing 3 of 12 · Footwear.
